effect_description_eng:
While you have a level 6 [Machine] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait. Delete that Digimon and 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to the chosen Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] By trashing 1 of your Digimon with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait from your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to the trashed Digimon's play cost.
